tagline: A free cookie banner and preferences window for Magento 2 with Google Consent Mode v2, scripts that wait for consent and an optional consent log, on Luma and Hyvä.
key_features: Cookie banner as a bar or a box
Preferences window with one switch per category
Google Consent Mode v2 defaults at the top of the head
Third-party scripts held back until consent
Scripts in Design Configuration can wait too
Refused cookies deleted in the browser
Optional consent log with export and retention
Hyvä and Luma templates, full-page cache safe

benefits.title: Tags wait for the visitor
benefits.text: Pixels, analytics and chat widgets you add in the admin are output as inactive markup and only run once their cookie category is accepted.

benefits.title: Google tags get the right signal
benefits.text: Consent Mode v2 defaults are printed before any CSS, JavaScript or tag manager, and returning visitors get their stored choice on the first hit.

benefits.title: Clear choices for shoppers
benefits.text: Accept all, reject all or choose per category, in an accessible window that visitors can reopen at any time from the footer or a floating button.

showcase.label: Banner
showcase.title: A banner that fits your theme
showcase.text: Full-width bar at the top or bottom, or a box in a corner or the centre. It uses your theme's fonts and buttons, or your own colours.

showcase.label: Preferences
showcase.title: One switch per category
showcase.text: Necessary, Preferences, Analytics and Marketing, plus categories of your own. Every text is a store view setting, so each language gets its own wording.

showcase.label: Hyvä
showcase.title: Native Hyvä templates
showcase.text: Tailwind templates for Hyvä 1.3+, driven by the same small vanilla script as Luma and picked automatically. Luma, Blank and their child themes get their own templates.

showcase.label: Mobile
showcase.title: Comfortable on phones
showcase.text: Buttons stack into full-width rows and the preferences window scrolls inside the screen, with a focus trap and Escape to close.

showcase.label: Third-party Scripts
showcase.title: Paste the snippet, pick the category
showcase.text: Each snippet has a category, a position (page head or end of body) and store views. The grid also lists scripts in Design Configuration that still load without consent.

showcase.label: Consent Log
showcase.title: Every choice on record
showcase.text: Optional log with a random consent ID, the choice, the accepted categories, the consent version and a keyed hash of the IP address. Export to CSV or XML.

feature_groups.title: Banner and preferences
items: Bar (top or bottom) or box (bottom left, bottom right, centre)
Accept all, Reject all and Manage preferences buttons
Footer link, floating button, CMS widget or any #cookie-settings link to reopen
Keyboard friendly: focus trap, Escape, labelled switches

feature_groups.title: Categories and cookies
items: Your own categories with their Google consent types
Consent stored in a first-party cookie with version and expiry
Raise the consent version to ask everybody again
Cookies of refused categories deleted in the browser

feature_groups.title: Google Consent Mode v2
items: consent default before any tag, consent update on every choice
dataLayer event commercegears_consent_update for GTM triggers
Replaces Magento's own cookie restriction notice

feature_groups.title: Scripts and developers
items: Admin-managed snippets per category, position and store view
Scripts, iframes, images and stylesheets held back until consent
Design Configuration scripts can wait for a category
JavaScript API (SwConsent) and a PHP ScriptBlocker
CLI: bump the consent version, clean the log
